engine.transport: localhost HTTP, uncompressed; load times are not internet download estimates

protocol.selection: Original speaker splits, baseline and probes; first three unused qualifying recordings from probe chapter.
protocol.speakerOnlyGate: Fewer genuine rejects and no additional other-speaker accepts, in each duration and split.
protocol.productionRelease: Blocked pending independent live sessions, phrase/quality gates, expiration policy, and a justified false-acceptance bound.
protocol.phraseCheck: not_evaluated: audiobook content is outside the randomized phrase bank
protocol.identityConfirmation: dataset_speaker_label: optimistic stand-in for independent owner confirmation
protocol.capture: Historical RMS trim; no browser microphone, audio processing, or Silero capture simulation.
protocol.chronology: Disjoint files, not dated sessions; no claim of later-day evaluation.

excluded.reason: Fewer than three unused qualifying supplement recordings

limitations: Public read speech; no proof of parity with the reported live failures.
Baseline and probes were used in earlier model studies; this is not a new independent validation corpus.
Supplement and probe files share a chapter; same-session benefit may overstate later-session benefit.
2s and 4s probes come from the same recordings and are correlated.
Dataset speaker labels stand in for trusted confirmation; no passkey flow is exercised.
Phrase checks, live capture quality, expiration, automatic updates, and poisoning resistance are not evaluated.
Bootstrap resamples probe speakers conditional on fixed templates; zero events do not bound population risk.
